name: read_captions
description:
Read captions as an SRT-like, time-ordered list of viewer-facing Cards.

Each Card has an id, start/end frame, viewer text, variants, edit state, sparse style override, and the caption revision required by Card-edit actions. Cards come from the committed caption plan and its persisted custom edits, NOT raw ASR words or a fresh tool-local pagination pass. Per-character ASR is grouped exactly as preview/export displays it. Bilingual original/translation variants for the same speech share Card timing.

Use Card ids with edit_captions set_card_text, set_card_tokens, set_card_style, set_card_span_style, set_card_layout, or merge_cards. When an @Captions reference already provides a Card id, pass it as cardId instead of searching the full caption list. Use atFrame=N for one exact canonical Card at a timeline frame, or fromFrame/toFrame for a half-open range [fromFrame,toFrame). If a legacy project cannot produce canonical Cards, atFrame asks for refresh instead of fabricating a clipped page from partial words. The global Caption Program config is reported once. Each Card reports layout.mode (program or card-width), effective geometry, sparse layout override, actual layoutLines, visualLineCount, numeric maxLines/maxCharactersPerLine, Card capacity, and overflow state. Card capacity is Max Lines × Max Characters per line. Font, preset, letter spacing, stroke, and other appearance changes do not change layoutLines or Card boundaries. A Card width override puts both dimensions of that Card's wrap constraint into Auto: Max Characters per line is derived from width and Max Lines becomes the number of visual rows the Card needs. This rewraps only that Card and preserves its boundary; other Cards keep their own constraints. Read width and layoutLines together after changing Max Characters or width. inlineStyles lists exact locally styled text spans so an agent can verify partial-text edits without inspecting preview pixels. A custom Card also includes editId for reset_card. Pass {"words":true} to inspect token ids, absolute frame ranges, timing provenance, and source-token links before split_card or set_card_tokens.

Captions use one timeline-level program plus chunked derived cues and sparse override items. The program may retain legacyTrackId/trackId only for old timeline lookup. Do not create or move tracks to style or route V1/V2 captions; use edit_captions source_update on the program. When `captionsItemId` is omitted, this tool uses the active timeline's caption program.

Use this before Card content or per-Card style edits. Track-wide style, template, layout, source, and translation actions do not require a read unless the request depends on current content. Output also shows:
- current caption config grouped as style / pagination density / layout, so agents can inspect stored parameters instead of guessing from a preset name
- sourceScope mode + per-source stable presentation identity, legacy aliases, and variant/language (original vs a translation)
- visual order: for stacked sources, which source renders lower vs above/top
- source diagnostics: if a source has audio but no usable transcript (no_audio / transcribing / error / empty / missing translation), the itemId + assetId + state are reported instead of silently empty captions
- translation coverage: after an operation resegments Cards, any missing/stale translated Cards are counted and an exact incremental edit_captions translate repair call is returned; run it without force, then read again to verify complete coverage

Results are paginated by top-level Card/page. limit defaults to 50 (max 100); when hasMore is true, call again with nextOffset, revision, and the same filters.

Card edits preserve transcript truth. Use manage_transcript action fix only when correcting source ASR. Legacy projects without a committed caption plan are reconciled once before reading. If their source transcript is genuinely unavailable, the tool returns a clearly marked non-addressable page fallback instead of pretending page indexes are Card ids.

json.description: Optional JSON: {"cardId":"cue:...","words":true} for one exact Card and its token ids, {"atFrame":4806} for one frame, {"fromFrame":4806,"toFrame":4830} for a half-open range, {"limit":50,"offset":50,"revision":"..."} to continue pagination, {"captionsItemId":"abc123"}, {"fullText":true}, {"refreshCache":true}, or {"includeSilence":true} for debugging ASR gap pseudo-words.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.
